risks: Experimental scope keeps leaking back into the stable story. Mitigation: Enforce explicit stable/experimental labeling in docs, examples, and tests.
completion_notes: Registered stable_backend and experimental_backend pytest markers in pyproject.toml. Tagged 7 codegen test files via module-level pytestmark: stable_backend on test_codegen.py, test_taichi_printer.py, test_taichi_printer_ul.py, test_emission_phase5.py; experimental_backend on test_cross_backend.py, test_mfem_printer.py, test_moose_printer.py. Test bodies untouched (each diff +2 lines). Selection disjoint: 102 stable / 19 experimental / 0 intersection. test_p5_5.py 3 tests use AST inspection (no import side effects, handles list+singleton pytestmark forms). cross_backend tests skip cleanly when MFEM_DIR/MOOSE absent — confirms stable suite independence by structural marker selection. Gate B identified one medium (count miscount in reviewer summary — implementer cited 102, fresh collect-only confirms 102) and two minor (test_emission_verification.py + test_emit_lame_conversion.py untagged — spec scope test_codegen*.py glob excludes them; Plan-B candidate). Plan-B follow-up: monkey-patch mfem_printer import to raise + assert stable suite passes — hardens independence beyond structural reflection.
